purpose: Verify an inter-system transition without sharing internal databases, ontology, or decision engine.
invariants: A signature proves origin/integrity, not legal correctness.
A mapping may be partial and MUST declare preserved/lost/rejected fields.
Decision time, valid time, and knowledge time are distinct.
A later correction MUST NOT silently rewrite the historical decision context.
Contradictions are preserved as signed assertions; the transport layer does not elect a winner.
Authority verification is scoped to issuer, role, jurisdiction, action, and validity interval.
The receiver MUST be able to reject a transition deterministically when a declared invariant fails.
